verdict.rationale: Homebrew collects anonymous analytics, so data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence only shows an analytics opt-out (`brew analytics off`), an adjacent collection control, with no documented control over how long collected data is retained or any way to delete it. Removing local taps and packages is local file management, not privacy data retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
